notes: Every number is a measurement on the Arc A770 with nothing else on the card (llama.cpp Vulkan, -ub 512); the ledger config/models.md holds the rows. This registry is read when A770B_CARD_MODE=inference; config/profiles.json is read in display mode. builder.env and the environment override any A770B_<NAME>_* value; the card reports what is served. useful_ctx is the largest depth at which decode stays above four tokens a second, taken from the 8k and far-end points by extending the time per token linearly, capped by the depth probe where one failed.

long.architecture: dense, hybrid attention (Gated DeltaNet + gated attention, 4 KV heads)

fit.code: T1 under the card line: 6 tests green in 122 s
fit.think: not measured (the thinking arm is owed)

long.use_for: The default: every ordinary change, tests from a specification, and a read up to its whole window at above five tokens a second; the depth probe is exact at 100k.

moe.architecture: mixture of experts, 40 blocks, 256 experts with 8 used, hybrid attention (2 KV heads); 18 expert layers in host RAM (--n-cpu-moe 18), 22 on the card

fit.code: T1 under the card line: 10 tests green in 203 s
fit.think: thinking mode measured: T1 nine tests green in 254 s under the card's 0.6/0.95 line, against ten in 203 s instruct; GPQA-Diamond 86.0 (the model card, BF16)

moe.use_for: A deliverable larger than its brief at three times the dense 27B's speed and its whole window at above ten tokens a second; needs 18 GB of host RAM for the run and a CPU that is busy; not beside another large load.

serious.architecture: dense, hybrid attention (4 KV heads, 64 blocks)

sampling.source: huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, thinking mode; reasoning effort low ruled for speed

serious.capability_source: ISTA-DASLab GSQ-RCO model card (quantiser's evaluation; BF16 85.71 / 89.90 / 100; the quantiser's task-lossless file)

fit.code: T1 under the card line: 10 tests green in 546 s at 196,608 (5 in 664 s at the client's temperature 0)
fit.think: GPQA-Diamond 89.39, AIME25 100 (the quantiser's card, IQ3_S vs BF16 89.90 / 100)

serious.use_for: A deliverable larger than its brief, tests from an unfamiliar module, a change touching several files: the best-written output here, at eight tokens a second; useful to about 98k by the four-tokens-a-second rule, so a long read costs minutes per 10k tokens.
